storage.intro: These are the folders where Sauri keeps your data. You can move them to another disk: Sauri copies everything, checks the copy and only then starts using the new folder.
storage.browserOnly: Open the Sauri app to change folders.
storage.browserOnlyHelp: This browser cannot reach your Mac's folders. In the Sauri app you can see how much space each one takes and move it.

recordings.hint: Audio, video and thumbnails of your meetings.

storage.missing: I can't find this folder. If it is on an external disk, connect it.
storage.moving: Copying and checking your data. Sauri pauses for a moment and comes back on its own when it finishes…

progress.choosing: Choose the new folder in the window that opened.
progress.verifying: Checking that the copy is complete…
progress.confirm_trash: Answer in the window that opened: do you want to move the previous folder to the Trash?
progress.trashing: Moving the previous folder to the Trash…
progress.label: Progress of moving the {{kind}} folder
progress.lessThanMinute: Less than a minute left to finish the copy.
progress.minutesLeft_one: About {{count}} minute left to finish the copy.
progress.minutesLeft_other: About {{count}} minutes left to finish the copy.
progress.keepOpen: Do not quit Sauri until it finishes. If anything interrupts it, your data stays intact in the previous folder.

storage.moved: Done: {{kind}} is now in {{path}}. The previous folder is still intact.
storage.movedTrashed: Done: {{kind}} is now in {{path}}. The previous folder was moved to the Trash.

errors.processing_one: {{count}} meeting is being processed. Wait for it to finish before changing folders.
errors.processing_other: {{count}} meetings are being processed. Wait for them to finish before changing folders.
errors.status_unavailable: I couldn't tell whether meetings are being processed. Try again in a moment.
errors.busy: A folder is already being moved. Wait for it to finish.
errors.same: That is already the folder Sauri uses.
errors.nested: Choose a folder that is not inside the current one and does not contain it.
errors.not_empty: That folder already has other files. Choose an empty one or create a new one.
errors.no_space: There isn't enough space on that disk: {{needed}} are needed and {{free}} are free.
errors.not_writable: Sauri can't write to that folder. Choose another one or check its permissions.
errors.not_a_directory: That path is a file, not a folder.
errors.foreign: That folder belongs to another Sauri installation.
errors.duplicate: Another kind of data already uses that folder. Use a different one for each.
errors.unsupported_file: The current folder has a shortcut or a special file that Sauri can't copy safely: {{detail}}
errors.copy_failed: The copy couldn't finish. Sauri keeps using the previous folder, which is intact. If you try again with the same folder, it continues where it stopped.
errors.verify_failed: The copy of {{detail}} does not match the original. Sauri keeps using the previous folder, which is intact.
errors.generic: I couldn't change the folder. Sauri keeps using the previous one.

summaries.help: Templates tell Sauri how to write a meeting's summary. The default template is used for automatic summaries. Changes only affect future summaries: existing ones keep the version they were generated with.
summaries.emptyCategory: There are no templates in this category yet.
summaries.empty: You don't have any templates yet.
summaries.defaultError: We couldn't change the default template. The previous one stays.

templateDialog.instructionsHelp: How Sauri should write the summary: structure, tone and what to highlight.
templateDialog.nameTooLong: The name can be up to 128 characters.
templateDialog.error: We couldn't save the template. Check the details and try again.

updates.title: Updates
updates.disabled: Automatic updates aren't available for this installation yet.
updates.ready: Sauri {{version}} is downloaded and checked. On restart, Sauri saves a copy of your database, prepares it for the new version and opens again. If anything fails, everything stays as it was.
updates.applying: Installing Sauri {{version}}. Sauri will close and open again by itself in a few seconds…
updates.checkFailed: We couldn't check for updates right now. We'll try again later.

errors.processing_one: {{count}} meeting is being processed. Try again when it finishes.
errors.processing_other: {{count}} meetings are being processed. Try again when they finish.
errors.status_unavailable: We couldn't check whether meetings are being processed, so we didn't update.
errors.not_writable: Sauri can't be replaced in the folder it's in. Open the file {{path}}, drag the Sauri that appears to Applications and open it again.
errors.migration_failed: The database couldn't be prepared for the new version. We restored the copy: you keep the current version and your data didn't change.
errors.generic: We couldn't install the update. You keep the current version and your data didn't change.
